profile.headline: Software Engineer | JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, React | 🍴 Foodie
profile.summary: I’m passionate about user experience! I love building software that people enjoy using, and I always make time to ensure interfaces are accessible, responsive, and intuitive. With 7+ years of full-stack experience in AI, Healthcare, and Biotech, I bring both technical skill and a user-first mindset. Let’s connect if you want to build something great together!

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
• Project lead for a technical documentation platform, showcasing and explaining APIs and models used by thousands of researchers
• Lead developer on a blog website platform for a top research institution, publishing 70+ posts and achieving 100K+ page views
• Built key features for an AI Chatbot used by 250k users, including a tool to browse thousands of sources behind responses
• Developed a reusable React component library for team of 20+ engineers with ADA accessibility compliance
• Improved Semantic Reader page-load performance by 30% through React and Webpack optimizations
• Optimized Elasticsearch author queries in Semantic Scholar, boosting result quality and cutting query latency by 20%.
• Developed a reusable React component library for team of 20+ engineers with ADA accessibility compliance
